label: Minimum age to get Accommodation Supplement
context: A person must be 16 or older, have accommodation costs above the entry threshold, be a New Zealand citizen or permanent resident who normally lives here and intends to stay, and not be paying rent for a public (social) housing property.

context: For homeowners getting Accommodation Supplement for the costs of owning a home, such as a mortgage, house insurance and rates, the entry threshold is this share of the relevant base rate.

context: From 1 April 2027 the entry threshold rises to this share of the relevant base rate for most homeowners.
